slides.title: Sound like [[you]]?
items: Still dark when the alarm rings

slides.title: Later, [[dimmer]] mornings
slides.body: In late fall, the sun rises later and the light stays soft. Your mornings start in the dark, so waking up can feel slower.

slides.title: Indoors all [[morning]]
slides.body: Commutes, desks and closed curtains keep you inside. Indoor light is much dimmer than daylight, even on a cloudy day.

items.head: Open curtains first
items.sub: Right after your alarm goes off

items.head: Take a 10-minute walk
items.sub: Morning light, even when it's cloudy

items.head: Sip coffee by a window
items.sub: Sit near daylight, not the lamp

slides.title: Daylight [[checklist]]
slides.note: Lifestyle tips only. If it lasts, talk to a professional.

slides.title: Say hi to the [[sun]]!
slides.body: Save, share and tell a friend

caption:
Still dark when your alarm goes off? ☀️

Late-fall sunrises come later, and most mornings are spent indoors under dim light.
Try three small habits starting tomorrow:
Open curtains first · Take a 10-minute walk · Sip coffee by a window
